speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will provide an effective anchor for economic and financial stability during a period of global and regional uncertainties.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will also actively promote innovations in finance.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Technology will challenge many existing players, but is a major opportunity for our financial centre.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will work with the industry to use technology to increase efficiency and lower costs of payments, enable financial institutions to expand their reach abroad, as well as better manage risks and provide benefit to customers, including ordinary savers.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Our core MAS policies should not change fundamentally.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: They aim to secure price stability during a period of transition when cost pressures are still significant and while the economy moves gradually towards productivity-led growth.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Financial sector supervision, the other major prong of MAS policies, will remain focused on pre-empting systemic risks to the financial system, promoting the safety and soundness of our financial institutions and ensuring well-functioning financial markets.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will also work with the industry to deepen our capital markets and the foreign exchange and derivatives markets; strengthen the asset management and insurance industries; and build a vibrant RMB ecosystem.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will regulate unconventional collective investment schemes to ensure consumers' interests are adequately safeguarded, while there will be wider bond and equity investment choices for retail investors.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The Singapore economy is experiencing modest growth, against the backdrop of uneven global economic health and ongoing restructuring of the domestic economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The divergence in monetary policies in the advanced economies, volatile capital flows and financial vulnerabilities in some emerging economies also pose new risks for the global system.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will continue to focus monetary policy on minimising overall economic volatility, while ensuring price stability in the coming years.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Since the global financial crisis, MAS has strengthened the regulatory framework for banks and insurance companies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS is reviewing the capital framework for insurance companies to make it more risk-sensitive.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We are also collaborating with the industry and other public agencies to strengthen the cyber resilience of the financial sector.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: To make OTC derivatives markets safer, MAS will implement central clearing and reporting of trades, as appropriate.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Page: 57 The financial sector is a critical gatekeeper in the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS has kept our rules in line with international standards and will continue to ensure that financial institutions have strong safeguards against illicit funds.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: In recent years, we have stepped up efforts to empower Singaporeans to better manage their finances and safeguard their interests.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will also regulate precious metals buy-back arrangements and collectively-managed investment schemes, to better safeguard consumers' interests when investing in such products.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We are also reviewing the use of a complexity-risk ratings framework for investment products, to facilitate sound financial decision making.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We are building a vibrant financial innovation ecosystem in Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will actively collaborate with the industry to make swift, simple and secure digital payments available to all individuals and businesses, encourage financial institutions to set up innovation laboratories in Singapore to test-bed solutions and provide a conducive regulatory environment for such innovation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Technology will open up new opportunities and change the nature of jobs in finance.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Financial institutions will also face challenges from new players who are out to disintermediate them.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will also ensure a strong Singapore Core in the financial sector.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for Economic and Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will work closely with financial institutions to provide Singaporeans with more opportunities to gain cross-functional and overseas exposure and to develop leaders with capabilities to take on responsibilities in Asia and beyond.
